help.usage:
cfb — Chis flash burner CLI

Usage: cfb <command> [options]

Commands:
  detect                       List serial ports and flag the burner
  info  [--port COMx]          Connect and read chip ID + capacity (auto-detects if --port omitted)
  burn  --rom <f> [--port]     Burn a GBA ROM (auto-detects if --port omitted)
  help  [command]              Show help (e.g. `cfb help burn`)

Global options:
  --lang <zh-CN|en>            Language (default: follow system, fallback zh-CN)

burn options:
  --rom  <path>     GBA ROM to burn
  --port <COMx>     Serial port (omit to auto-detect the burner)
  --log  <path>     Log file (default cfb_<time>.log)
  --chip-erase      Whole-chip erase (default: per-sector erase-then-write)
  --no-ppb          Skip PPB unlock
  --no-verify       Skip verify + repair

Run `cfb help <command>` for per-command help.
help.detect:
cfb detect — list all serial ports and identify the burner

  Enumerates serial ports, flags the burner by USB VID/PID ({0}/{1}),
  and shows whether each port can be opened (busy detection). No arguments.

  Example: cfb detect
help.info:
cfb info [--port COMx] — read chip info

  Connects to the burner, powers on, reads Flash chip ID and CFI (capacity/buffer/sectors).
  Auto-detects the first burner when --port is omitted.

  Example: cfb info
           cfb info --port COM7
help.burn:
cfb burn --rom <file.gba> [options] — burn a GBA ROM

  --rom  <path>     GBA ROM to burn
  --port <COMx>     Serial port (omit to auto-detect the burner)
  --log  <path>     Log file (default cfb_<time>.log)
  --chip-erase      Whole-chip erase (default: per-sector erase-then-write)
  --no-ppb          Skip PPB unlock
  --no-verify       Skip verify + repair

  Example: cfb burn --rom game.gba          (auto port)
           cfb burn --port COM7 --rom game.gba
